title: Simultaneous depth-cutoff bands retain a ComCat-GCMT change difference at 10-12 km for matched M5.8+ events in 2005-2020
abstract: We extended a matched ComCat-GCMT depth comparison from separate cutoffs to a simultaneous band over 66 cutoffs from 5 to 70 km. The sample has 3,734 matched ComCat M5.8+ events in 2005-2020. We compared 2005-2012 with 2013-2020. The change in the ComCat share minus the change in the GCMT centroid share reached 6.69 percentage points at 11 km. Its approximate 95% simultaneous limits were 2.28 to 11.11 points under three-year circular year blocks. Cutoffs 10-12 and 20-21 km retained positive lower limits under one-, three- and four-year blocks. The 30 km pointwise interval excluded zero, but the simultaneous band did not. No individual cutoff cleared the FREE-only centroid band, although its average curve score was positive. The data overlap prior work. Eight-year eras, depth errors, matching selection and different depth definitions limit inference. This is a stronger check of cutoff choice, not evidence of physical shallowing. Code, aggregate counts, draws, provenance and an independent matching audit are included; external records remain separate.

display.caption: Paired era contrast and approximate 95% simultaneous bands over integer cutoffs from 5 to 70 km. Three-year circular year blocks; full sample and FREE-only sample.
